description: VIDEO FACE SWAP, face only: every frame gets the new face; hair, body, clothes, expressions, background and sound stay (recast_motion swaps the whole person). Up to 30 s with one face clearly in view (longer clips are cut to 30 s). A frame with no face keeps its own picture and is not charged. Priced per frame; dryRun returns this clip's price. Using a real person’s face, likeness or voice confirms you are them or have their consent, take full, unlimited responsibility for its use and will cover any claim against Hermoso (hermoso.ai/terms). Paid plan only; recorded.
